statements.markdown: **Theorem D.3 (unbounded shared-prefix families represent one half).** *Suppose that for every $N$ there are $M,K$ with $\max\{N,1\}\le M$, $0\le K\le M$, and a family satisfying all the conditions in the preceding paragraph. Then $X_A(2)=1/2$ for some infinite set $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}_{>0}$.*
